title: Human test and operator validation
summary: Add an explicit milestone for a human-run validation pass of the autonomous system and its operator-facing workflow.
note: User requested an explicit human test milestone.

new_milestone.title: Human test and operator validation
new_milestone.objective: Run a human-operated validation pass against the autonomous development system, capture the operator experience, and record concrete findings before declaring the workflow fully production-ready.
acceptance: A repo-defined human test plan exists with explicit scope, steps, and pass/fail criteria.
The human test exercises the autonomous workflow from an operator perspective rather than only automated verification.
Human test results are captured in repo-owned evidence or audit surfaces.
Follow-up issues or gaps discovered during the human test are routed back into the milestone system explicitly.
verify: Review the human test plan and operator instructions.
Perform one human-run validation pass and record the outcome.
